description: A driver wants to log an intermittent noise or warning sign precisely enough that a mechanic can reproduce it, including temperature, speed, road conditions, and dashboard behavior.

user_profile.persona: 31-year-old commuter whose car behaves differently on longer highway drives
user_profile.context: The issue never appears on command, making verbal descriptions too vague to be useful at the shop
user_profile.communication_style: Observational and systematic, prefers to collect evidence before seeking conclusions

fact_sheet.fact: The driver's name is Alex Corbin, born on July 15, 1993.
Alex Corbin's daily commute is a 45-mile trip each way on the I-580 highway.
The vehicle is a 2019 Lumina Veloce sedan in 'Graphite Gray Metallic'.
The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) is 9KLM890PQR7S123T4.
As of October 25, 2024, the vehicle's odometer reads 72,451 miles.
The Lumina Veloce is equipped with a 2.0L turbocharged engine and an 8-speed automatic transmission.
An intermittent, high-pitched whining noise emanates from the front-right wheel area of the vehicle.
The whining noise is consistently accompanied by the 'Traction Control Off' dashboard light flickering.
The issue has only been observed after the vehicle has been driven continuously for at least 30 minutes.
The issue has never occurred at vehicle speeds below 60 miles per hour.
On October 18, 2024, at 5:45 PM, the issue occurred for 90 seconds while driving at a constant 72 mph.
During the October 18th incident, the ambient air temperature reported by the car's sensor was 58°F (14.4°C).
The road condition during the October 18th incident was dry asphalt on a straight highway section.
On October 22, 2024, at 7:10 AM, the issue reappeared for approximately 3 minutes while traveling at 68 mph on a slight incline.
The ambient temperature during the October 22nd incident was 65°F (18.3°C).
No specific driver actions, such as braking or turning, seem to trigger the onset or conclusion of the issue.
Alex Corbin recorded a 25-second audio clip of the whining noise on October 22nd; the file is named `whine_102224.m4a`.
Alex uses the 'CarLog Pro' mobile app, version 3.1.2, to record incident data.
The CarLog Pro app connects to the vehicle's OBD-II port using a 'BlueLink Mini' Bluetooth adapter.
Alex's user account for sharing CarLog Pro data with the mechanic is `ac Corbin@email-host.net`.
The vehicle is serviced at Apex Auto Repair, located at 1550 Industrial Way, Northwood, CA 94063.
The primary service advisor for Alex Corbin at Apex Auto Repair is David Chen.
The lead technician assigned to diagnose complex electronic issues is Maria Rodriguez.
The vehicle's last service was a 70,000-mile maintenance check on September 5, 2024, with no reported issues.
A diagnostic appointment is scheduled at Apex Auto Repair for October 28, 2024, at 9:00 AM.
The work order number for the October 28th appointment is WO-2024-8915.
